nota: Tiempos exactos: la pista es la concatenación de los audios de cada segmento con pausas fijas.

segmentos.texto: Volunteers wanted for the Green Park Summer Festival!
Do you like helping people?
Are you free on July twelfth and thirteenth?
We need forty volunteers, and we want you!
We have jobs for all kinds of people.
You don't need any experience, but some skills are very useful.
Can you speak another language?
A lot of visitors come from other countries, and they often need help.
We need Spanish, French and Chinese speakers at the information desk.
Can you cook?
Our food tent needs six people in the kitchen.
Are you good with children?
In the family area, volunteers paint faces and play games with children.
Can you drive?
We need four drivers with a license.
They take chairs and tables from our office to the park.
All volunteers are sixteen or older.
You can choose your hours: mornings, from eight to one, or afternoons, from one to six.
Every volunteer gets a free T-shirt, a free lunch and two tickets for the evening concert.
How can you join?
You can write to Sam at the festival office.
Your email needs three things: your name, your age and your skills.
Can you bring a friend?
Yes, of course you can!
